fields.description: Program Description After completing the teaching content specified in the teaching training plan, completing credits, and defending the graduation thesis, you can obtain a graduation certificate. Those who meet the requirements of the bachelor's degree are awarded a bachelor's degree certificate. In addition, our school can also accept students who have graduated from this program. Applicants who have obtained a bachelor's degree from a foreign university can directly enter the third-year study of relevant professional universities of our university after completing the admission, complete the teaching content specified in the teaching training plan, and obtain a graduation certificate after answering a graduation thesis. If conditions permit, award a bachelor's degree certificate.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Copies of the academic transcript both the original and a copy notarized by the Chinese Embassy * 2. Study plan in China * 3. Electronic photo(JPG) Pixel quality must be greater than 1M. * 4. The applicant’s passport Passport must be valid beyond the intended period of study in China. * 5. No criminal record certificate notarized by the Chinese Embassy. * 6. Certificate of HSK * 7. A copy of the highest academic certificate * 8. Original of the highest academic qualification notarized by the Chinese Embassy. The applicant who is still at school has to submit a certificate of attendance or pre-graduation certificate issued by the school currently being attended. Moreover, after admission, the applicant must submit the original academic qualification and a copy notarized by the Chinese Embassy. 9. Certificates of various awards during study or work * 10. A photocopy of the Foreign Physical Examination Record This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese health and quarantine department and a blood test report. Applicants should strictly follow the guidelines of the Foreign Physical Examination Record. The Foreign Physical Examination Record is invalid if it is incomplete, without the signature of the doctor and the official stamp of the hospital, or without the photo of the applicant and the cross-page seal on the photo. The applicant is requested to do the medical examination within the 3 months before arriving in China. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. AIDS laboratory report(a seperate report) * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements The undergraduate program applicants must be between 18-22 years old. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens who have a foreign passport and be friendly to China. A Chinese emigrant applying to study in Ningxia University must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years, and in addition, the applicant must have a record of living abroad for more than two years within last four years(before April 30th of the application year). Undergraduate program applicants should be fresh high school graduates or have a high school diploma with good grades in secondary school. Applicants for bachelor's degree in Chinese Language and Literature (International Chinese Language Education Direction) should have the new HSK level 4 and the score should be above 180 points; Non-Chinese Language and Literature undergraduate applicants, Chinese level must reach the new HSK level 4 and the score should be above 240 points. No criminal record, no history of drug use. In good health, no serious infectious diseases. CSCA subjects requirements download here .
